_COMMENT_Y_PLACEMENT: Macro Y increased from 200 to 400 µm to give wrapper bottom tap rows clearance from macro nwell boundary. This should eliminate the nwell.4/LU.3/nwell.2a DRC violations at y≈13-15µm seen in prior runs.
_COMMENT_ELABORATE_ONLY: SYNTH_ELABORATE_ONLY=true treats the macro as a black box during synthesis. Prevents Yosys from re-flattening.
_COMMENT_ASSIGN_CHECKER: ERROR_ON_NL_ASSIGN_STATEMENTS=false suppresses the assign-statement checker. Required because Yosys generates assign for bus concatenations in elaborate-only mode.
_COMMENT_MARCO_TYPO: LVS_INCLUDE_MARCO_NETLISTS — 'MARCO' is a typo in LibreLane 2.4.6 source. Must match exactly.
_COMMENT_RESIZER: RUN_POST_CTS/GRT_RESIZER_TIMING=true — required for hold timing. Without these, hold violations abort the flow (runs 1-12 failure root cause).
